title.zh: 给 SQL 汇总加一道门槛
title.en: Add a Cutoff to a SQL Summary

brief.zh: 先用 SQL 把读数压成几组，再试试仅显示达到门槛的组。
brief.en: Group the readings in SQL, then try keeping only groups that meet a cutoff.

concept.zh: GROUP BY 决定分组。HAVING 在组的统计量算好后筛掉不合条件的组。
concept.en: GROUP BY creates the groups. HAVING filters groups after their statistics have been calculated.

hints.zh: 选择按区域计数，把汇总下限从 0 调到 4，看看哪个区域消失了。
hints.en: Count by area and raise the aggregate minimum from 0 to 4. Which area disappears?

label.zh: 改变分组、统计量和门槛

prompt.zh: 对照运行两次，只改变汇总下限，看看 HAVING 改变了哪些输出行。
prompt.en: Run twice and change just the aggregate minimum. See which result rows HAVING removes.
